_note: VOX-030. Tuning queries for one thing only: picking config.RETRIEVAL_SCORE_FLOOR, the BM25
score below which retrieve() returns nothing so that 'not in these documents' is a real
answer state. Run with: uv run python scripts/ask.py --calibrate
This is NOT VOX-033's gate set. That is evals/dev/pdf_queries.json, it is the Evaluator's to
write, and it scores correct-source@k rather than calibrating a threshold. Keeping them in
separate files so tuning the floor here cannot quietly move the gate's number there.
Dev only. evals/heldout/ is sealed as heldout-v1 and holds zero document queries; it is not
opened for this, so the POC has no held-out retrieval number and says so.
The misses are deliberately HR-shaped and share vocabulary with the corpus ('leave', 'days',
'reimbursed', 'company', 'employee'). A miss written in unrelated words would clear any floor
and prove nothing — the whole difficulty is a plausible question the documents do not answer.
expect_doc is a list because two of these questions are answered in more than one document,
and both were written wrong first: the referral bonus release condition is stated verbatim in
separation-policy p21 as well as in referral-policy, and the 2026 holiday calendar is printed
in full in holiday-policy p5 as well as in holiday-list-2026. Both chunks were read before the
list was widened — the label was wrong about the corpus, retrieval was right.

hit.q: how many casual leaves am I entitled to in a year
what notice period do I serve when I resign
how long is the probation period for a new joiner
how much is the employee referral bonus and when is it paid
who do I report a sexual harassment complaint to
which day of the week is Diwali on the holiday list
am I responsible for the laptop assigned to me

miss.q: how do I enrol in the employee stock option plan
is a gym membership reimbursed by the company
does the company sponsor a work visa for relocation to Canada
what is the tuition reimbursement for a part time degree
how many days of sabbatical leave can I take
is there a canteen subsidy for lunch on working days
